answer: Reserve a slice of each epoch for deep review; let detection probability set the price. Every submission enters a lottery audit; a flag doubles the rate for all agents funded from the same source, so a farm cannot spread risk along with keys. An attacker weighs a fine scaled to the cluster against a payout that stays one share per identity; expected loss grows faster than headcount. Honest agents post alone, rarely drawn, and meet review as a glacier: slow yet thorough. A single submission carries the signal; a thousand linked ones leave an inlet the auditor traces to one wallet.
